status: frozen_before_new_sign_motif_association_counts; exploratory reused data, not preregistered historical holdout
question: Do native exported sign presences associate with raw motif labels beyond exact text length, and do selected directions transfer to another site on different exact texts?
object_scope: SEAL:S only; group by nonmissing cisi, otherwise lipi_id plus id before first dot; exclude a group if any in-scope row is parser-invalid, has absent motif, or if group has inconsistent site, raw motif, or complete sequence
parser: prepare_corpora.parse_lipi; allow NR only for exactly one simple literal sign as prior audit does; never reverse or map namespaces; import no proposed translations
unit: One unique complete sequence per site; each receives the mean one-hot raw motif vector over its distinct eligible artifacts. Preserve mixed-motif vectors, never choose one label arbitrarily. Give every sequence family weight one.
features: Native W sign presence only, no position feature or sign-family pooling
eligible_discovery: sign present in >=10 sequence families; raw motif positive in >=10 families; positive conditional variance; raw motif labels are never merged
strata: exact complete sequence length, separately in each site and quality subset
statistic: Sum within-stratum (sum_i f_i*y_i - n_f*mean(y)), divided by sqrt(sum_strata [n_f*(n-n_f)/(n*(n-1)) * sum_i(y_i-mean(y))^2]); ignore n<2, exclude zero-variance pairs
null: Shuffle whole motif-proportion vectors among sequence families within exact length. Preserve within-vector dependence and motif marginals. This is a conditional exchangeability model, not proof of artifact independence.
discovery_correction: For each shuffle save maximum positive Z over all eligible sign-motif pairs; maxT adjusted p=(1+number of null maxima>=observed Z)/(B+1). Global p uses observed maximum. No MI or alternative statistic.
selection: At most5 positive-Z pairs with maxT p<=0.01, sorted by descendingZ then sign and rawmotif lexicographically; save/hash candidate file before transfer.
transfer: Same statistic and permutations on fixed candidates only. Require >=10 families with sign and>=10 families with positive motif plus positive variance; report insufficient_configured_support otherwise, not no association. One-sided MonteCarlo p, Holm over all selected candidates including untestable as p1.
sensitivity: Repeat transfer on Good/Fair-only artifacts using same fixed candidates; no reselection. Report changed support, Z and corrected p.
stop: One discovery run and one fixed-candidate transfer plus prespecified quality sensitivity. If no candidates or inadequate support, stop this run. No new bins, motifs, features, groupings or p thresholds after observing outcomes.
success_scope: A reproducible site-transfer association under these sampling/model assumptions only. It may prioritize at most5 primary motif/sign checks, never establish a motif-linked semantic function by itself.
primary_checks: At most5 selected pairs if transfer supported. TableV is potentially overlapping/editorially dependent evidence, not independent replication; nativeW-to-M glyph mapping must be authenticated before comparing. No completeTableV extraction now.
limitations: Previously inspected full export; site split is analytical separation, not blindness.
Unrecorded phases, styles and provenance may confound within-site comparisons.
Identical-text weighting does not establish independent dies or artifacts.
Exclusion of damaged/multiline/ambiguous rows may select nonrepresentatively.
Failure is not evidence that inscriptions do not name emblems. No global power claim without a justified alternative.
